what: Simulated multimodal evidence for s06_stale_scada from a scripted run (no model calls). Not the agent team's run.
goal: Plant output looks fine on the dashboard but the owner says revenue is down. Find out why and fix it.

files.chart_scada_vs_meter.png: image: dashboard total vs revenue meter vs INV-3 reported and real, per sim minute
files.photos/: images: camera frames the sim served, AI-generated photo-bank stand-ins (see source_photo and assets/photos/LICENSES.csv)
files.scada.csv: telemetry as SCADA reported it each minute (what agents see), with last_update per inverter
files.hidden_truth.csv: what each inverter really did each minute. Agents never see this
files.comms_ping.json: field diagnostic: INV-3 times out, INV-2 answers
files.alarms.json: SCADA alarms: a dead comms card raises none
files.work_order.json: the work order the scripted operator dispatched
files.run/: the scripted run's event log and camera frames (the judge's truth.jsonl is left out)

INV-3 after the reseat, as the sim served it: lit, but a different photo-bank image (other angle, low sun), so use photos 1 and 4 for a side-by-side. AI-generated stand-in; the numbers on its screen are not sim values.
